description: The same engine with `initial=.Idle`, a declared variant. Isolates the variant-membership condition.
rationale: §51.0.E — `initial=` names the variant the engine mounts in. A name absent from the `for=` enum cannot be mounted, and because `initial=` is resolved at construction the failure would otherwise surface as a runtime throw on first paint. Rejecting at compile time is the §51.0.E contract.
